The '''Little Kessel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]<ref name="TEA" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Little Kessel]].<ref name="Twitter" />
